s.zh: 冥想调息：职业资源回满
不需要睡觉的身体用静坐代替长休：原地静坐
s.en: A body that doesn't need sleep sits in meditation instead of a long rest: meditate in place for

s.zh: 小时，结束时所有职业资源（斗志、气、神恩、法力、契约法力）回满。中途被打断就没有效果。\n平时不在战斗中、未征召时，每 6 小时也会自动回上限的 1/4。
s.en: hours, and at the end all class resources (fighting spirit, ki, divine favor, mana, pact mana) are refilled. Interruptions mean no effect.\nNormally, when not in combat and undrafted, 1/4 of the cap also recovers automatically every 6 hours.
